notes: Eight distinct movable-part episodes are visible. The two leaves of each double-door closet were treated separately, as were the two clearly separated utensil-drawer cycles. Leaf-specific timing during the rapid closet-closing sequences is approximate because the panels overlap and the camera is moving.
scene_description: A first-person traversal of an apartment entry, coat closet, laundry closet, kitchen, and living area. The user successively opens and closes closet leaves, an integrated refrigerator, an upper spice cabinet, and a lower utensil drawer.
